newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore "Hooters" to play down sex appeal.
newsitem.headline: Singapore "Hooters" to play down sex appeal.

text.p: The Singapore version of the Hooters American restaurant chain will tone down the feminine sex appeal that is a main selling point in the United States, the Straits Times newspaper said on Friday.

In the United States, where "hooters" is slang for breasts, the restaurants are known for well-endowed waitresses dressed in jogging shorts and tank-tops tightly knotted behind their backs to help emphasise the figure.
But while the Singapore outlet due to open in December has advertised for women with "cheerleader" looks, it plans to give them a choice of tops permitting a more conservative look.
The Straits Times quoted the managers as saying they intend to tone down the sex appeal angle of the restaurant.
"It's Singapore," Razak Kamisan, assistant operations manager of Hooters, was quoted as saying.
"We want to be careful. We don't want to give people the wrong impression and have them think this is a sleazy place."
Singapore, with a no-nonsense approach to law and order and an emphasis on family values, has a reputation among Asian cities for being strait-laced.
